images.title: File:Tea towels (set of) (AM 2002.64.1-1).jpg
images.author: Ina Sodersten
images.description: Set of seven embroidered 'Monday to Sunday' tea towels, c1950s-1960s. Made by Mrs Ina A Sodersten, of Ngaruawahia, almost certainly from transfer patterns. rectangular white linen tea towels; selvedge at sides; machine-sewn rolled hem at top and bottom; hand embroidered motifs at bottom centre of each towel with child-like doll figure performing household duties specific to the day of the week which is embroidered on each towel- .1- 'Wash-on-Monday' in graduated Red embroidery; motif- baby with Red-pink bow in hair standing on stool washing from bowl .2- 'Sew-on-Tuesday' in graduated blue embroidery; embroidered motif of baby with yellow bow in hair sitting on stool sewing with basket of sewing implements .3- 'Garden-on-Wednesday' in yellow embroidery; embroidered motif of baby with butterflies watering flowers with watering can .4- 'Clean-on-Thursday' in green embroidery; embroidered motif of baby with purple bow in hair mopping floor .5- 'Bake-on-Friday' in Red embroidery; embroidered motif of aby in baker's hat holding cale recipe book surrounded by pieces of kitchen equipment .6- 'Shop-on-Saturday' in blue embroidery; embroidered motif of baby carrying jam jar and flour bag in front of brick wall .7- 'Church-on-Sunday' in graduated yellow embroidery; embroidered motif of baby with flowers in hair reading Bible
